what_this_does_not_establish: mtimes are mutable and clocks can be wrong. This is evidence against the ordinary failure -- a manifest written or amended after the run -- not proof against a determined edit.
why_committer_date: %ct, not %at: an author date is settable with --date and is therefore an operand the author controls.
why_the_minimum: one artifact written before the commit falsifies the claim even if the other 49 came after, so the operand is min(mtime), not the mean or the first found.
